name: Cassian Holt
subtitle: Fallen nobility
summary: Seeking adventure and riches to restore his fallen house.
tableNote: Courteous, but sensitive about his family name.
adventureHook: He needs companions to recover a lost family heirloom.
imageAlt: Cassian Holt in a red cloak and dark armor in a sunlit city

name: Mira Fen
subtitle: Herbalist and healer
summary: A precise apothecary whose remedies carry a hint of old magic.
tableNote: Warm and observant; she remembers every favor.
adventureHook: A rare moonflower she needs grows beyond the old city walls.
imageAlt: Mira Fen surrounded by bottles and herbs in her apothecary

name: Brother Alden
subtitle: Keeper of the dawn chapel
summary: A steadfast priest protecting a secret beneath his quiet chapel.
tableNote: Speaks gently and pauses before answering direct questions.
adventureHook: The chapel bells ring each midnight, though no one pulls the ropes.
imageAlt: Brother Alden in pale ceremonial robes before a tall chapel window

name: Nessa Vale
subtitle: Harbor runner
summary: A daring smuggler who knows every hidden route through the harbor.
tableNote: Quick to laugh, quicker to notice an unguarded purse.
adventureHook: One of her trusted routes has begun delivering ships to the wrong coast.
imageAlt: Nessa Vale in a dark leather coat overlooking a busy harbor
